title: PERIGEE
description: At the edge of curved spacetime. A full-screen 3D relativistic Schwarzschild black hole scroll experience and geodesic telemetry observatory.
stack: Next.js 16 · React 19 · Three.js WebGL · GSAP · Lenis

sections.title: THE SHADOW (`r = 38.0 → 24.0 Rs`)
sections.summary: Wide orbital establisher in deep space. The black hole sits slightly off-center with a rolled horizon (`roll = -0.15`), bending background starlight around the Einstein ring. Headline `"PERIGEE"` and `"Light does not travel in straight lines."`

sections.title: ACCRETION PLANE (`r = 24.0 → 9.0 Rs`)
sections.summary: The camera levels roll and descends above the equatorial plane of the accretion disk (`pitch → 0.03`). Keplerian differential rotation shears past the lens. Copy: `"Matter in terminal orbit. Superheated plasma shearing at forty percent the speed of light."`

sections.title: DOPPLER LIMB (`r = 9.0 → 4.8 Rs`)
sections.summary: The camera banks sharply (`roll → -0.32`) into the approaching left wing. Relativistic Doppler beaming shifts plasma to blue-white brilliance while the receding wing fades to infrared. Copy: `"Relativistic beaming. What approaches blinds; what recedes fades into infrared."`

sections.title: THE PHOTON SPHERE (`r = 4.8 → 1.65 Rs`, Signature Interactive Moment)
sections.summary: Camera hovers at the razor-thin glowing Photon Ring (`r = 1.5 Rs`). The user can drag in space to launch test-photon geodesics into the gravity well—watching them spiral across the horizon, execute a 180° hairpin gravitational slingshot, or deflect into deep space. Copy: `"The photon sphere. Where gravity traps light in a closed circular mirror."`

sections.title: INNERMOST STABLE ORBIT (`r = 1.65 → 1.18 Rs`)
sections.summary: Camera skims above the Event Horizon shadow (`r = 1.0 Rs`). Extreme gravitational time dilation. Four crisp architectural callout labels pin around the anatomy of the hole: `"Event Horizon (1.0 Rs)"`, `"Photon Sphere (1.5 Rs)"`, `"ISCO Boundary (3.0 Rs)"`, and `"Secondary Lensed Image"`.

sections.title: POLAR ESCAPE (`r = 1.18 → 18.0 Rs` North Polar Ascent)
sections.summary: Camera arcs over the north pole looking down into the spinning vortex as a collimated Relativistic Polar Jet ignites upward. Displays a `"Request Observation Window / Telemetry Feed"` console with client-side validation and animated ephemeris lock.
